title: NSFWJS – Client-side NSFW Image Detection in JavaScript
meta_description: NSFWJS is a free, open-source JavaScript library that detects NSFW and nude images right in the browser or Node.js with TensorFlow.js. Images never leave the device. Try the live demo.
body:
What is NSFWJS?
NSFWJS is a free, open-source (MIT) JavaScript library that flags NSFW, nude, and pornographic images. It runs a TensorFlow.js model right in the browser or in Node.js, so images never have to be uploaded to a server. The demo above runs NSFWJS on your device: your images stay private.
Install
npm install nsfwjs @tensorflow/tfjs
Quick start
import * as nsfwjs from "nsfwjs";
const img = document.getElementById("img");
const model = await nsfwjs.load();
const predictions = await model.classify(img);
// [{ className: "Neutral", probability: 0.93 }, ...]
Full API docs, caching, backend selection (WebGL, WebGPU, WASM, Node), and self-hosting the model are in the NSFWJS README on GitHub.
Image categories
- Drawing: safe-for-work drawings, including anime
- Hentai: hentai and pornographic drawings
- Neutral: safe-for-work neutral images
- Porn: pornographic images and sexual acts
- Sexy: sexually explicit images that are not pornography
Models
| Model | Accuracy | Size | 
|---|---|---|
| MobileNetV2 (default) | ~90% | 2.6 MB | 
| MobileNetV2Mid | ~93% | 4.2 MB | 
| InceptionV3 | ~93% | Large | 
FAQ
Are my images uploaded anywhere?
No. Classification happens entirely on your device with TensorFlow.js. Nothing is sent to a server.
Does NSFWJS work in Node.js?
        Yes. Pair it with @tensorflow/tfjs-node for fast server-side classification.
      
Can I use it in a mobile app?
Yes. See the NSFWJS mobile demo for React Native.
How accurate is it?
About 90% with the small model and about 93% with the mid-sized model. It isn't perfect, but it gets more accurate all the time.

meta_description: Databricks offers a unified platform for data, analytics and AI. Build better AI with a data-centric approach. Simplify ETL, data warehousing, governance and AI on the Data + AI Platform.
body:
A lakebase delivers the unified transactional layer that ties together your data, AI and governance, making it easy to build, deploy and manage production applications on a single platform.
The next generation of analytics is here. From natural language dashboard creation to deep conversational analytics with Genie, this is BI built on AI from the start. Now, everyone can explore data and uncover insights.
Databricks is a unified data and AI platform that runs both analytical and operational workloads on one open, governed foundation. It enables organizations to build BI and AI applications, stream and analyze data, and process daily operations with consistent security, performance, and governance — all without adding complexity or having to copy data.
How to try Databricks?
Get started with Databricks for free. No credit card required.
Lakebase is a new kind of database that merges the reliability and developer experience of Postgres with the scale, governance, and analytics power of a data lakehouse. It lets teams run transactional workloads while seamlessly syncing data to analytics and AI systems, without building custom ETL pipelines. The result is one platform where apps, data, and models work together in real time.
A data warehouse is a data management system that stores current and historical data from multiple sources in a business-friendly manner for easier insights and reporting. Data warehouses are typically used for BI, analytics, reporting, data applications, preparing data for ML, and data analysis.
Data warehouses make it possible to quickly and easily analyze business data uploaded from operational systems such as point-of-sale systems, inventory management systems, or marketing or sales databases. Data may pass through an operational data store and require data cleansing to ensure data quality before it can be used in the data warehouse for reporting.
Databricks Genie is a conversational analytics interface within the Databricks Data + AI Platform that enables business users to get instant insights from their enterprise data using natural language — no SQL or coding required. Instead of submitting requests to data teams or navigating complex BI tools, users ask plain-language questions like "How is my sales pipeline performing?" and Genie responds with text summaries, tabular data, and visualizations.
Unity Gateway is a multi-AI governance and cost control solution that helps organizations manage access, spend, and observability across agents, tools, models, and MCPs from a single governed layer.
A data lakehouse is a data architecture that combines the low-cost, flexible storage of a data lake with the ACID transactions, schema enforcement, and fast SQL performance of a data warehouse — built on open data formats like Delta Lake, so there's no proprietary lock-in.

Founded in January 2023, GPTZero has served over 20 million users to date and works with 100+ organizations in education, hiring, publishing, legal and more.
AI detectors work by looking for patterns in text that are more likely to have been written by a machine than a human. The most common factors they look for include: Perplexity: Is the writing obviously predictable? Burstiness: How much variation is there in the sentence length and style? Style: Is the tone and writing style overly generic or repetitive? GPTZero uses its own proprietary model that takes hundreds of factors into consideration and boasts the highest detection accuracy in the industry

Independent benchmarks, like our partners at Penn State's AI Research Lab, and our own large-scale testing show that GPTZero is the most accurate AI detector, with a 99.9% accuracy rate when spotting AI-generated text vs. human writing. Our results were further validated on RAID, a comprehensive, third-party benchmark where GPTZero was shown to be the most accurate AI detector in North America, detecting 95.7% of AI texts while only incorrectly predicting 1% of human texts as AI, an accuracy that jumps to over 99% when filtering to modern LLMs like GPT4. Unlike many competitors, GPTZero can reliably detect "mixed documents" (where human and AI writing are combined) with a 96.5% accuracy rate. While no AI detector can ever truly be 100% perfect, we are committed to being a leader in responsible adoption of AI generation and AI detection technologies.
